import json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
body=(root/'notebook.html').read_text()
prior=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:notebook.html'],text=True)
entry=body.split('<article class="research-entry" id="entry-2026-09-14-bit-PHP-publication-audit">',1)[1].split('</article>',1)[0]
added='\n'.join(x[1:] for x in subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--unified=0','--','notebook.html'],text=True).splitlines() if x.startswith('+') and not x.startswith('+++'))
ids=re.findall(r'\bid="([^"]+)"',body)
links=sorted(set(re.findall(r'href="#([^"]+)"',added)))
assert all(ids.count(x)==1 for x in links)
record='<section id="research-record">'
marker='<!-- Append new dated mathematical entries here, preserving earlier entries. -->'
old_record=prior.split(record,1)[1].split(marker,1)[0].rstrip()
assert body.split(record,1)[1].startswith(old_record)
source=json.loads(Path('research/results/'+ 'bit_php_literature_encoding_audit_20260914_132' +'/sources.json').read_text())
assert len(source['sources'])==6
assert all(ids.count(a)==1 for a in source['internal_dependency_anchors_reviewed'])
assert body.count('<!-- TIMING bit_php_literature_encoding_audit_20260914_132 -->')==1
assert max(map(len,Path('/tmp/math-commit132.txt').read_text().splitlines()))<=100
out={'scope':'Touched links, source metadata, append-only record, timing marker, and commit-message width; no mathematical computation rerun','new_entry':'entry-2026-09-14-bit-PHP-publication-audit','internal_links_checked':links,'source_count':6,'old_record_unchanged':True,'status':'pass'}
p=Path('research/results/bit_php_literature_encoding_audit_20260914_132/metadata-check.json')
p.write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':'pass','links':len(links),'sources':6,'old_record_unchanged':True}))
